name: Petty Cash — Daily
query:
SELECT
  pce.dated AS `Date`,
  pce.description AS `Description`,
  pce.department AS `Department`,
  pce.account AS `Account`,
  pce.payment_method AS `Payment Method`,
  pce.amount AS `Amount`
FROM `tabPetty Cash Entry` pce
WHERE pce.docstatus < 2
  AND pce.dated = %(dated)s
ORDER BY pce.creation
